summary: Legs A day. Lunch pivots to roasted salmon for protein variety (fish, after a run of chicken mains), with deli turkey breast added for extra lean protein. Dinner brings in blackened chicken thigh plus extra turkey breast, with more rice, sweet potato and black beans for leg-day recovery carbs. Pre-workout is the wellness-bar cottage cheese protein smoothie (tropical, no berry flavor today) with banana and dried apricot.

meals.note: Eggs and turkey for protein, oats and multigrain toast with honey for steady carbs, banana and raspberries for fiber.
